Cool new data! 


## Did internal influence change with COVID? 

-> No

Why? 

- perceived importance did not change
- perceived importance changed, but did not affect response times 
  - perhaps email is all about the org chart, but policy is about expertise

## Interpretation; influence over agency outputs

May not be true in all cases, but true enough that its probably a good measure. 

if speed is related to kinds of importance that are more or less related to power over outputs. 

For example, a boss may evaluate employees on how fast they write rules, but not their content. 



## Did anything else happen? 

To believe this null reflects no change influence, we may a comparable case of *change* in influence. 

> within-employee response rates are faster when emails are sent by senior and higher-earning employees
